emails.subject: Engagement letter - Stein Legal immigration matter
emails.body:
Hi Omar,

I'm Rachel Stein. The Stein Legal immigration practice has assigned me to your H-1B and green-card matter, and your signed engagement letter is on file.

I've seen the courier's notice about the missing exhibits. The petition packet we rebuilt from the scanned copies of your employment documents the other night is complete now. Sunday afternoon at the office works for me if you'd like to go through it page by page before we refile.

Rachel

emails.subject: Re: Engagement letter - Stein Legal immigration matter
emails.body:
Rachel,

Thank you. Sunday is fine. I didn't realize the firm would work on a weekend for this, I assumed I'd just have to wait in the queue.

I'll bring my originals and the courier receipt so we can check the rebuilt packet against them.

Omar

emails.subject: Re: Engagement letter - Stein Legal immigration matter
emails.body:
Omar,

The RFE on your I-140 is in. I've put a consult on the calendar for next Thursday at 9:00 so we can go over the response together. Please bring your pay stubs from the past two years; the rest we already have.

For what it's worth, your employment records were the most organized set I've received this year. That will make the response much easier.

Rachel
